name: Humane Society of New York (HSNY)
aka: The Humane Society of New York
neighborhoods: Citywide (clinic in Manhattan); community-cat spay/neuter for all boroughs
notes:
Free spay/neuter for community cats + left eartip, rabies, flea/ear-mite meds. Each cat must arrive in a separate covered trap - no exceptions. No post-surgery boarding. Verify appt availability. Intake: Call to schedule Intake: 30-9:30am day of surgery Other channel: 306 East 59th Street, New York, NY 10022
